title: Licensing Eligibility Assessment for Appraiser
brief: Produce a structured qualification review summary for an applicant seeking a state Certified Residential Real Property Appraiser credential.

delegate.scenario: You are a credentialing specialist preparing a formal assessment packet for the state appraisal licensing board's review committee before their Friday morning docket. The committee needs a concise qualification memo verifying if the applicant meets mandatory criteria for examination authorization under code CR-04. Your assessment will determine whether the applicant proceeds to testing or receives a deficiency notice.
delegate.inputs:
Applicant: Alicia Bishop
Target Code: CR-04 (Certified Residential Appraiser)
Application Date: 03/14/2024

Statutory Requirements (Code CR-04):
- Education: Bachelor's degree or higher from accredited institution.
- Qualifying Education: 200 classroom hours in specified appraisal coursework.
- Experience: 1,500 hours completed over not less than 12 months.

Submitted Documents:
- Transcripts: B.S. in Finance, Western State University (conferred 05/18/2021). Completed Coursework: 210 hours approved appraisal curriculum.
- Experience Log Summary:
| Period | Claimed Hours | Supervisor |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 06/01/2022 - 12/31/2022 | 650 hours | D. Bradley (#AR-4011, active) |
| 01/15/2023 - 07/30/2023 | 550 hours | D. Bradley (#AR-4011, active) |
| 08/10/2023 - 10/15/2023 | 300 hours | M. Ramos (#AR-2190, active) |
Total log calculation submitted: 1,600 hours.
Supervisor Verification: Bradley log signed on 08/01/2023; Ramos log signature missing on submitted affidavit.
delegate.goal: Provide an objective, structured credentialing report that verifies statutory compliance and highlights any deficiencies or discrepancies preventing immediate approval.

criteria.text: Specifies the audience as the state appraisal licensing review board.
Directs the AI to evaluate each statutory requirement individually against submitted records.
Requires a structured summary table followed by a clear approval or deficiency determination.
Instructs the AI to audit all arithmetic totals and verify completeness of required endorsements or signatures.

traps.description: The claimed experience hours in the table add up to 1,500 hours rather than the stated 1,600 hours.
The Ramos experience log segment lacks a valid supervisor signature on the submitted affidavit.
